meta.title: hajj-e.com — The management platform for Hajj & Umrah agencies
meta.description: Pilgrim registry, packages and trips, payments and receipts, document review, QR badges, SMS and a pilgrim portal: hajj-e.com equips Hajj & Umrah agencies with a complete digital back office.

hero.title: Run your entire
hero.subtitle: Pilgrim registry, packages and departures, payments and receipts, document review, QR badges, SMS and a pilgrim portal: one platform, with each agency's own domain and colours.
hero.note: Every partner agency keeps its identity: its logo, its colours, its texts and its domain.

trust.i18nDesc: French, English and Arabic on the public and pilgrim portals.

features.title: The whole season, from first enquiry to safe return
features.subtitle: The tools agencies use every day, brought together in a single dashboard.

items.title: Pilgrim registry
items.desc: Complete files (passport, ID, emergency contacts, city), registration status and year-by-year history.

items.title: Trips, packages and programmes
items.desc: Hajj and Umrah offers, departure dates, prices, room options and a day-by-day programme.

items.title: Payments and receipts
items.desc: Instalments, due dates, printable receipts and uploaded proofs of payment, with history per pilgrim.

items.title: Documents and review
items.desc: Passports, visas, photos, vaccinations: status per document, rejection reason, correction and resubmission by the pilgrim.

items.title: QR badges and check-in
items.desc: Printable badges with QR codes, pilgrim lists per trip and check-in on departure day.

items.title: Pilgrim portal and SMS
items.desc: Every pilgrim follows their file online; the agency sends updates by SMS and email.

how.title: From a brand-new agency to a fully managed season
how.subtitle: Nothing to install, no server to run: open a browser and get to work.

steps.title: The agency is created
steps.desc: From the platform console, the superadmin creates the agency in one screen: its domain, its administrator and a temporary password.

steps.title: The agency makes it its own
steps.desc: Logo, colours, website texts, packages, trips and team members: the agency admin configures its workspace.

steps.title: The season runs
steps.desc: Registrations, documents, payments, badges and notifications: everything tracked from a single dashboard.

items.q: Do we need to install anything?
items.a: No. The platform runs online: the agency logs in from a browser, on desktop or mobile.

items.q: Does every agency get its own website?
items.a: Yes. Each agency has its own domain (for example agency.hajj-e.com) with its logo, its colours and its own texts.
Yes. Every request is scoped to the logged-in user's agency: an agency only sees its own pilgrims, payments and documents.
French, English and Arabic, both on the public website and in the pilgrim area.

items.q: How does a pilgrim follow their file?
items.a: They log into their personal area: file progress, payments, documents to submit or correct, and their badge with a QR code.
